contents.content: So Much to Do at Work

contents.value: My phone started to vibrate. The little red light in the corner started to blink erratically. I thought it might be running low on battery but that wasn't the case. When I went to go pick it up, I knocked over the glass of water on my desk. It got all over my phone! I saw everything on the screen vanish! I went to grab it. It's now sitting in a bag of rice. I checked to see if it was working and it appears to have stopped working altogether.

_data.content:
This test will check what you have learned in this lesson.
  • Express necessity, duty, and advice.
  • Request or report facts about events or actions related to work issues.
  • Express my work responsibilities.
  • Talk about an unusual or unique event related to work topics.
  • Discuss hopes and expectations for the future.
